title: Gao Lut House - MVN Group - NOAM Architectural mark on the international stage
description: Gao Lut House, an award-winning project by MVN Group - NOAM Architecture, explores human-centered design through natural light, local materials, climate adaptation, and the warmth of family living.
author: MVN Group
content:
Gao Lut House has gone beyond the boundaries of a conventional residential project to WIN the WA Awards – WA Realised Award category, marking a Vietnamese architectural project on the international stage.

 

 

The award recognized 35 outstanding projects from 17 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Latin America. In the Architecture Realised category – dedicated to completed and operational buildings – only 15 projects were honored, with Gao Lut House being the only representative from Vietnam, standing alongside projects from China, Spain, South Korea, Brazil, Costa Rica, and Latvia…

Gao Lut House began with the everyday story of a young family working in the technology sector in Da Nang. The house was not conceived from a desire to create a distinctive architectural form, but from fundamental human needs: natural light, privacy, natural ventilation, a sense of peace, and connection among family members.

The name “Gao Lut” evokes the image of grains of rice in natural, rustic colors yet full of vitality; it is also associated with the family’s young daughter – Rice. From there, light became one of the key materials through which the story of the house is told.

On a 90 m² site with an open façade directly exposed to the southwest sun, the architects chose a building envelope combining terracotta bricks, tiled roofs, reclaimed wood, exposed concrete, together with natural ventilation and daylighting systems.

 

 

Familiar materials not only create the architectural character but also contribute to adapting the house to Da Nang’s climate. During the day, light is moderated as it penetrates deeper into the spaces; at night, light from within passes through the building envelope, creating the image of glowing “grains of rice” – a metaphor for vitality and the warmth of family.

At Gao Lut House, human-centered architecture is not an abstract or grand concept. It is simply architecture that begins by understanding how people will live within the house.

The project was recognized by the World Architecture Community with the WA Award – Cycle 52, adding another milestone to the journey of MVN Group - NOAM Architecture in pursuing contemporary living spaces connected to people, climate, materials, and local memories.

Project: Gao Lut House
Architecture: MVN Group - NOAM
Lead Architect: Truong Anh Vuong
Main Contractor: MVN Group
Location: Da Nang, Viet Nam
Completed: 2024
Award: WA Award – Cycle 52
